scoring_justification: Checker independently recomputes the Köhler and deliquescence curves using the same public equations and constants, then elementwise compares the agent's submitted arrays against the recomputed reference. Full reward is achievable by any correct implementation.

outputs.description: The checker independently recomputes the same curves using the same public theory and constants, then compares the submitted arrays elementwise with a tolerance and verifies the crossover diameter.

output_contract.notes: All physical constants and material parameters are publicly known; the agent embeds them in the code. The checker recomputes its own reference from identical equations and parameters, so no external gold file is needed.
